primary: Agreement with accepted version over both orders; unreadable counts as failure, item bootstrap.

keyword reason categories, multiple codes allowed
method costs and sum of request latency

strict_rule: Whole response JSON object, exactly better/confidence/reason, A/B exact, numeric finite 0-100, nonempty reason <=2 heuristic sentences.
lenient_rule: First complete JSON object anywhere, allow extra fields, case/whitespace normalize A/B, coerce numeric confidence; do not recover the choice from plain prose or reasoning.
baseline: Unweighted violations; fewer wins; ties undecided; main score counts ties as failure.
limitations: Merged acceptance is a preference label, not independent human paragraph ratings.
